meta.faltan: atributos y descripción corta de WooCommerce

fichas.h1: Rock Marble Coffee Table by Rugiano
fichas.h1_regla: opción más buscada: 'marble coffee table' (33100/mes); la descripción cubre las opciones: marble, wood
fichas.descripcion:
The Rock is a Rugiano coffee table with a shaped top, available in painted wood or marble. Designed by Rugiano, it comes in two sizes. Made in Italy.

TOP OPTIONS

  • Wood: the wood table version has a Decoro decorated painted wood top.
  • Marble: the marble table version offers a wide range of marble options.

SIZE AND FRAME

Both versions share the same two bronzed brass metal legs. Choose the top first, then the size. See all coffee tables.
fichas.descripcion_original: The Italian Rock coffee table features a stylish shaped top available in Decoro decorated painted wood or in a wide range of marble options. This versatile low table, available in two different sizes, has two refined legs made of bronzed brass metal. An innovative and functional coffee table to complement sophisticated sofas. Designed by Rugiano. Made in Italy.

validacion.razon: Todos los datos (tapa de forma especial en madera pintada Decoro o mármol, dos tamaños, dos patas de latón bronceado, Made in Italy, diseño Rugiano) provienen de la ficha; no hay invenciones ni contradicciones. Las keywords 'wood table' y 'marble table' se usan con su sentido real dentro de las opciones de tapa, y 'rugiano coffee table' aparece de forma natural. El H1 identifica producto, material y marca; aunque el mármol es solo una de las dos opciones de tapa, es un rasgo válido y no un detalle menor. Hay una leve redundancia entre la intro y las secciones, pero no afecta la corrección de los datos ni la legibilidad.

fichas.descripcion:
The Club Sofa by Rugiano is a designer Italian club style sofa, a club couch with a structure of brushed brass or bronze drawn tubes and leather or fabric upholstery. Made in Italy.

FRAME AND UPHOLSTERY

  • Brushed brass: drawn tubes form the structure, combined with the upholstery.
  • Bronze: drawn tubes form the structure, combined with the upholstery.
  • Leather: upholstery combined with the drawn-tube structure.
  • Fabric: upholstery combined with the drawn-tube structure.

Choose brass or bronze for the frame and leather or fabric for the upholstery; this Rugiano sofa fits a sophisticated living area. See all sofas and sectionals.
fichas.descripcion_original: This is a designer Italian Sofa, part of the exclusive Club collection. It stands out for the innovative structure created by refined brushed brass or bronze drawn tubes that, combined with the upholstered leather or fabric, create a stylish pattern. A high-end Glamour furniture, ideal to fit in any sophisticated living area.Made in Italy.

validacion.razon: Todos los datos (Italian, Made in Italy, estructura de tubos de latón cepillado o bronce, tapizado en cuero o tela, ambiente sofisticado) provienen de la ficha; no hay contradicciones ni invenciones. El H1 identifica producto y marca, y las keywords se insertan de forma legible. Las viñetas repiten la misma idea con otro orden, pero no aportan datos falsos ni contradicen la ficha.

fichas.h1: Hermes Maxi Upholstered King Bed by DV Home Collection
fichas.descripcion:
The Hermes Maxi bed is an upholstered king bed from DV Home Collection, with a multilayer frame padded in non-deformable polyurethane foam. Its large headboard has vertical quilting. Made in Italy.

UPHOLSTERY OPTIONS

This Hermes bed comes in fabric or leather, in a wide range of options. Both cover the same frame and the quilted headboard.

HEADBOARD AND CUSHIONS

Square goose feather decorative cushions are optional and available on request. Choose the upholstery first, then ask for the cushions, and browse our king beds for other frames.
fichas.descripcion_original:
Part of the Italian Hermes collection, this double bed is offered with a multilayer structure covered with non-deformable polyurethane foam.

The upholstery is offered in a wide range of fabric or leather options and the large headboard features a refined vertical quilting. Also, to add more comfort, goose feather square decorative cushions (19”5/8 or 15”3/4) are available upon request.

Elegance and Glamour characterize this versatile Italian furniture piece. Made in Italy.

validacion.razon: Todos los datos (estructura multilayered con espuma de poliuretano no deformable, cabecero con acolchado vertical, tapizado en tela o cuero, cojines de pluma de ganso opcionales bajo pedido, Made in Italy) provienen de la ficha. El H1 indica qué es el producto (cama king tapizada) con marca y colección. Las keywords 'hermes bed' y 'maxi bed' aparecen de forma natural, sin contradicciones ni datos inventados.

fichas.h1: Tiffany Multilayered Wall Mirror by DV Home Collection
fichas.descripcion:
The Tiffany style mirror is a multilayered wall mirror by DV Home Collection, made in Italy with a natural mirror and a frame in six finishes.

FRAME FINISHES

Choose shining stainless steel, antique bronze satin, shaded glossy, shaded satin, chrome black or 24Kt gold. All Tiffany mirrors share the same structure; the finish sets the look for a hallway, bedroom or entry.

See more wall mirrors.
fichas.descripcion_original: The exclusive Italian Tiffany mirror comes with a multilayered structure. Natural mirror (1/8” thick). The refined frame is offered in shining stainless steel, antique bronze satin, shaded glossy, shaded satin, chrome black or dipped in 24Kt gold. This luxury Italian piece will surely add a Glamour style to any interior space. Made in Italy.

validacion.razon: El H1 identifica el producto por su estructura (multilayered wall mirror) y marca, sin elegir un rasgo menor. La descripción respeta los datos: Made in Italy, natural mirror, las seis opciones de acabado están bien contadas y nombradas, y no se inventan materiales ni certificaciones. Las keywords aparecen de forma natural y las menciones de hallway/bedroom/entry son ubicaciones genéricas coherentes con un espejo de pared ('any interior space'), no un dato inventado.

fichas.h1: Cleopatra Wood and Leather Dining Chair by OAK
fichas.h1_regla: el producto es de wood and leather (primera oración; 'wood and leather chair' 1300/mes)
fichas.descripcion:
The Cleopatra wooden chair by OAK is a wood and leather chair with a wooden frame. The Cleopatra chair design is a dining chair, and this OAK dining chair comes in three wood finishes.

WOOD FINISHES

The wooden frame is available in:

  • Rosewood
  • Ebony
  • Citronier

Choose one of the three when you order.

LEATHER UPHOLSTERY

The upholstery is leather.

Find more dining chairs in the category.
fichas.descripcion_original: Wooden chair with leather upholstery. Rosewood, Ebony or Citronier finish.

issues: Keyword forzada: "The Cleopatra chair design is a dining chair" es una tautología que solo existe para ubicar "cleopatra chair design"; no aporta información nueva.

Repetición/relleno (tono): el primer párrafo dice la misma idea tres veces ("wooden chair", "wood and leather chair with a wooden frame", "is a dining chair, and this OAK dining chair..."), con "chair" repetido hasta cinco veces.
Relleno: la sección "LEATHER UPHOLSTERY" se limita a "The upholstery is leather.", que ya estaba dicho en el primer párrafo.
validacion.razon: Los datos (3 acabados, cuero, marca OAK, tipo dining chair) son correctos, pero la descripción acumula keyword stuffing y frases de relleno que repiten lo mismo.

fichas.h1: Cruise Teak Outdoor Sofa by Talenti
fichas.descripcion:
The Cruise is a teak outdoor sofa by Talenti, a cruise couch built around a teak wood structure. Made in Italy.

TEAK AND ROPE

The teak sofa frame is entirely in teak wood, while synthetic rope defines the backrest and armrests. The cushions use weather-resistant fabrics for outdoor living areas.

OUTDOOR USE

The weather-resistant cushions and three-seat layout make this Talenti sofa suitable for relaxed outdoor seating. For more options, browse our outdoor sofas.
fichas.descripcion_original: The exclusive three seater sofa of the refined Cruise teak collection is created with a nautical and nature inspired style. Indeed, the high-end structure is entirely realized in teak wood, the use of synthetic rope is reserved to the armrests and backrest and the cushions are made with weather resistant fabrics, making the product perfect for outdoor living areas. Here you have a stylish Italian furniture ideal for relaxing moments outside.Made in Italy.

validacion.razon: Todos los datos coinciden con la ficha (estructura íntegramente en teak, cuerda sintética en brazos y respaldo, cojines con tejidos resistentes a la intemperie, tres plazas, Made in Italy). El H1 identifica producto, material y marca, y ambas keywords se integran con sentido; solo hay una leve redundancia de 'teak' que no constituye dato inventado ni contradicción.

fichas.h1: Bakkarat Glass Dining Table by Tonelli Design
fichas.descripcion:
The Bakkarat is a glass table by Tonelli Design with an extra-clear glass top and a chrome-plated metal base. Made in Italy.

TOP AND BASE

This dining table in glass pairs a clear top with a sculptural central leg. The chrome-plated base reflects light and contrasts with the glass. Because the leg is central, the perimeter stays open for chairs.

Choose it for a dining room where the table is seen from all sides. See all dining tables.
fichas.descripcion_original: Bakkarat is a refined Italian table in extra clear glass. The top’s slab creates an elegant contrast with the round top and sculptural central leg that rest on a chrome-plated metal base. Ideal for interior designers that want to incorporate high-end Italian products with a timeless design to their projects. Made in Italy.

validacion.razon: El H1 identifica el producto por material y forma (glass dining table) y la marca. La descripción se limita a datos de la ficha (extra-clear glass, chrome-plated metal base, sculptural central leg, Made in Italy), sin contradicciones ni keywords forzadas. Las inferencias prácticas (base cromada que refleja luz, perímetro libre por la pata central) se derivan de los atributos y no constituyen datos inventados.

fichas.h1: Illan Wood Wall Sconce by Luceplan
fichas.descripcion:
The Illan lamp is a wall sconce by Luceplan, designed by Zsuzsanna Horvath. A die-cast aluminum body holds the LED and throws light upward; the layered wood shade gives it the geometric silhouette. Made in Italy.

LIGHT AND DIMMING

21W, 1265lm, 2700K or 3000K, CRI 90, dimmable, and UL approved.

SURPLUS WOOD SHADE

The shade is laser-cut, ultra-thin and flexible wood, taken from surplus left over from making the Luceplan Illan suspension lamp.

This wood sconce is for walls where light should wash upward rather than down; browse our wall sconces if you need a different format.
fichas.descripcion_original:
The Illan wall lamp brings the poetic lightness and innovative spirit of Zsuzsanna Horvath’s design into a refined, space-saving format. This elegant wall light features a die-cast aluminum body housing an efficient LED source that casts a soft, warm glow upward, enriching interiors with atmospheric, eco-friendly illumination. Its distinctive shade is crafted from laser-cut, layered wood, an ultra-thin and flexible material that defines Illan’s iconic geometric silhouette. In a commitment to sustainable design, the wooden element is made from surplus material left over from producing the Illan suspension lamp, transforming production scraps into a sculptural, decorative feature.

Lightweight, contemporary, and environmentally conscious, the Illan wall lamp is a perfect choice for those seeking designer wall lighting, warm LED ambience, and Italian craftsmanship that merges technology, beauty, and sustainability. UL Approved (Product build according to the National Electrical Code’s requirements and tested by Underwriters Laboratories). Made in Italy.

Light source: LED 21W 1265lm 2700K/3000K CRI 90 Dimmable. UL Approved.

validacion.razon: Todos los datos (aluminio die-cast, madera cortada a láser de excedente del suspension Illan, 21W/1265lm/2700-3000K/CRI 90/dimmable/UL, Made in Italy, diseño de Zsuzsanna Horvath, luz hacia arriba) están respaldados por la ficha. H1 identifica producto, material y marca. Keywords integradas con naturalidad, sin contradicciones ni relleno.

fichas.h1: Steinway Mother-of-Pearl Piano by Riva Mobili D'Arte
fichas.h1_regla: rasgo más buscado: 'mother of pearl piano' (110/mes); el volumen del nombre (27100/mes) es de la marca steinway, no de esta pieza
fichas.descripcion:
The 19800 Steinway Piano is a Riva Mobili D'Arte piano with hand-carved decorations on the base and sides and mother-of-pearl inlays across the surface. Made in Italy.

CARVINGS AND INLAYS

  • Hand-carved details along the base and sides.
  • Mother-of-pearl inlays on the surface, reflecting light in iridescent shades.

The deciding factor on this mother of pearl piano is the decoration itself: carving on the base and sides, inlay on the surface. For the rest of the workshop's output, see Riva Mobili D'Arte pianos.
fichas.descripcion_original: Piano of extraordinary elegance that is a true masterpiece of fine craftsmanship. Every detail reveals exceptional artisanal mastery: from the harmonious structure to the rich, refined carvings that adorn the base and sides. The hand-carved decorations embody timeless artistry and lend the instrument an aura of grandeur and prestige. The surface is embellished with mother-of-pearl inlays, a noble and luminous material that reflects light in iridescent shades, creating an effect of refined sophistication. This piano is a true work of art, a symbol of an era when manual skill and aesthetic taste achieved a level of absolute perfection. Made in Italy.

omitidas.motivo: La ficha no menciona a Steinway & Sons como fabricante: la marca es Riva Mobili D'Arte. Usar la frase afirmaría un origen que la ficha no dice.

validacion.razon: La descripción se ciñe a la ficha: piano Steinway 19800 de Riva Mobili D'Arte, tallas a mano en base y laterales, incrustaciones de nácar en la superficie y Made in Italy, todo respaldado por el texto original. El H1 identifica producto, material distintivo y marca; no hay datos inventados, contradicciones ni keyword forzada (la keyword aparece de forma natural). La frase final repite lo ya dicho a modo de cierre con enlace interno, sin llegar a ser relleno de catálogo.

fichas.descripcion:
Shibari chairs are fully covered in stretch fabric: curved tubular metal legs rise and converge at the backrest, forming a knot. This Visionnaire armchair merges structure and form in a single outline.

THE KNOT

The knot has carried meanings of joining, devotion and eternity in Egyptian, Buddhist and Chinese symbolism. Here it ties the legs to the backrest without a visible break.

SEAT AND SUPPORT

A high-density polyurethane core and a webbed seat carry the support, so the chair stays solid without looking heavy. The cover runs over the whole frame; nothing is left exposed. Compare it with other chairs and armchairs.
fichas.descripcion_original:
The Shibari chair comes fully covered in stretch fabric, featuring a continuous and enveloping silhouette. The curved tubular metal legs converge at the backrest, forming a fluid knot that merges structure and formal expression. The high-density polyurethane core and webbed seat ensure comfort and support, striking a balance between visual lightness and structural solidity.

Across history the knot has had many different meanings, including sacred and religious symbolism. In Egypt it represented life: the knot of Isis stood for immortality and divine love. The endless knot is one of the most ancient figures utilized in Buddhist symbolism in China and Tibet, but also in geographically distant zones, to convey a sense of infinite devotion. Tying and knotting mean joining, connecting two objects, bringing them together in harmonious progress. Since ancient times the knot has had a clear meaning of junction and commitment between two people. This meaning is immediately associated with love, precisely to emphasize the inseparable nature of a bond.

This symbol conveys meanings of eternity and faithfulness. A knot made properly will not come undone, opening and separating the two objects it holds fast. Therefore a love knot unites two people forever. It is not a noose, not a tight restraint, but an intertwined connection, representing a sense of give and take, of help in moments of need. It is a soft knot that links without duress. Extended horizontally, it reminds us of the symbol of infinity: what could be a better way to represent everlasting love?

omitidas.motivo: El orden invertido no forma una frase natural en inglés: solo entraría rompiendo la sintaxis de la oración (por ejemplo, separando el sustantivo de su nombre de modelo) o escribiendo algo que no significa nada para el lector.

validacion.razon: El H1 identifica correctamente el producto (armchair de tela de Visionnaire) y la descripción se ciñe a los datos de la ficha: tapizado íntegro en stretch fabric, patas tubulares metálicas curvas que convergen en el respaldo formando un nudo, núcleo de poliuretano de alta densidad y asiento con cinchas, y el simbolismo del nudo en Egipto, budismo y China. Las keywords se integran con naturalidad y sin cambiar de sentido. Como observación menor (no bloqueante), 'nothing is left exposed' es una leve hipérbole derivada de 'fully covered in stretch fabric', aunque las patas metálicas quedarían visibles.
